issue.title: Replace Settings Menu Overlay with Slide-Out Panel
issue.body: The current settings and accounts menu appears as a floating overlay card anchored near the top of the screen. This ticket replaces that overlay with a full-height slide-out panel that opens from the left edge, giving the menu more vertical room and a more native mobile feel. ## Functional Requirements ### Slide-Out Panel - Replace the overlay card with a panel that slides in from the left edge, covering the full screen height - Size the panel width to fit its content; leave the remaining screen area visible beneath a scrim - Dismiss the panel when the user taps the scrim or swipes left - Animate the panel sliding in and out on open and close ### Menu Content - Retain all existing menu items and their order, icons, labels, and behaviors from the current overlay menu ### Sign Out - Keep Sign Out visually separated from the rest of the menu items, as in the current design

comments.body:
**Test Results #255**

- The Settings panel opens correctly, and all icons and labels are clearly visible.
- The overlay menu has been replaced with a panel that slides in from the left and covers the full height of the screen.
- The panel width adjusts to fit its content, and the rest of the screen remains visible with a dimmed background (scrim).

**Issues Found**

- The panel closes when the user taps the dimmed background (scrim), but it does not close when swiping left.
- The slide-in and slide-out animation when opening and closing the panel is not implemented.


Moving this issue to In progress
